flashcard_questions.q: A community of living organisms interacting with each other and their non-living environment in a particular area.
All the organisms of one species living in a particular area at a particular time.
All the populations of different species living and interacting in an area.

flashcard_questions.a: The biogeochemical cycle by which carbon moves between the atmosphere, living organisms, oceans, and rocks through processes such as photosynthesis, respiration, combustion, and decomposition.
The continuous movement of water between the Earth’s surface, atmosphere, and underground through evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and transpiration.
